subject: Unforeseen electrical field condition: panel location conflicting with the new wall

messages.text: We de-energized the circuit and logged the panel location conflicting with the new wall framing at Room 214 in today's field log; this isn't reflected in Sheet E-501. No rush on this -- please respond when convenient. There will be a cost impact to address this condition. This is not holding up other work currently. Please respond within five days so we can proceed.
